title: Disease Severity Estimation
subtitle: Pixel-level semantic segmentation of leaf damage and necrotic lesions
mildDesc: Isolated spots; crop defense system is active. Preventive spray recommended.
moderateDesc: Spreading lesions; active intervention required within 48 hours.
severeDesc: Heavy tissue damage; curative fungicide spray required immediately.
criticalDesc: Widespread necrosis; isolate infected section to protect rest of the field.
